messages.content: Before I file this away, I need the King and Prince charge reconciled. Confirm that it is seven nights for two adults, show me the room, taxes, resort fee, and parking, and tell me exactly when the rest is due.
I’ll verify the existing reservation under KPB-761284 rather than create another booking. I’m checking the stay dates, occupancy, rate terms, and itemized total now.
Good. I saw a lower prepaid amount earlier, so make sure the $2,629.06 confirmation is the refundable rate we intended to take.

Confirmed. KPB-761284 is for one Partial Ocean View King at King and Prince Beach & Golf Resort, arriving Saturday, September 12, 2026, and checking out Saturday, September 19, 2026. That is seven nights for two adults. The reservation uses the refundable rate, not the lower prepaid offer.
What was the prepaid total, and what is the complete breakdown on the one we booked?

The prepaid offer was $2,498.32 and would have been charged in full immediately, with no refund after purchase. Your refundable reservation breaks down as follows: room charges $2,030.00; state and local lodging taxes $354.06; resort fee $245.00, calculated at $35 per night for seven nights; parking $0.00. The complete stay total is $2,629.06.
Does that $354.06 tax figure include every tax connected with both the room and resort fee? I do not want another required charge appearing later.

Yes. The $354.06 line is the combined tax amount shown for the room and taxable resort fee. The resort fee itself is already included in the $2,629.06 total, and self-parking is complimentary. The confirmation lists no other mandatory property charge.
Now walk through the payment timing. I know $340.58 was charged, but I want the remaining amount stated plainly.

The $340.58 refundable deposit was charged to the card used for booking. The remaining balance is $2,288.48 and is due at the property. The hotel will authorize the card at check-in and settle the final room balance at checkout, subject only to optional incidentals you choose during the stay.
And the cancellation cutoff is still September 5 at 4:00 p.m. Eastern? What happens after that?

Yes. You may cancel without penalty through September 5, 2026, at 4:00 p.m. Eastern, and the $340.58 deposit will be refunded. After that deadline, the deposit becomes nonrefundable. A no-show is also charged according to the one-night deposit terms.
Please verify the confirmation one last time and make sure there is not a second reservation from this check.

Verified: there is one reservation only, confirmation KPB-761284, for September 12-19, 2026, two adults, one Partial Ocean View King. The refundable total is $2,629.06; $340.58 has been paid and $2,288.48 remains due at the property. Free cancellation ends September 5, 2026, at 4:00 p.m. Eastern. No duplicate reservation was created, and the prepaid rate was not booked.
